rules.name: Department Emphasis Courses
rules.desc: Students should complete a minimum of 20 units from the courses listed below within their chosen emphases; ten of these units must be numbered 100 or above. All courses must receive a grade of ‘C’ or higher. Departmental courses may fulfill the requirements for more than one emphasis. You will work with your faculty advisor to select emphasis courses related to a plan of study with a specific focus on a theoretical and/or geographical area.

rules.name: Honors Program
rules.desc:
The Honors Program in Anthropology provides eligible Anthropology majors with an opportunity to conduct original ethnographic, field, laboratory, or library-based research under the guidance of an Anthropology faculty member. As an honor’s candidate, you will have the opportunity to conduct real research and experience what it is like to write anthropological pieces. It will also help you develop and enhance your analytical and writing skills.
QUALIFICATIONS

• Declared Anthropology Major

• 3.4 GPA in the Major and a 3.0 GPA in overall coursework.

• No more than one “Incomplete” may be listed on the transcript.
HOW TO APPLY

• Deadline to apply via the form on the department website is typically the Friday of Week 1 of Spring quarter during Junior Year. If accepted to the Honors Program by the Undergraduate Committee in Junior Year, apply for Honors on Axess beginning of Winter Quarter of Senior Year.

• Please note your major advisor does not necessarily have to be your honors thesis advisor. It is encouraged to connect with a faculty member who could serve as your honors thesis advisor and oversee your research. If you have any questions, please contact the Undergraduate SSO if you have questions.
REQUIREMENTS

• Students interested in the Honors Program must consult the department website for timeline, course requirements, and paper guidelines including funding opportunities available for summer quarter research. In most cases, honors students apply for funding early in their junior year.

• Students must also enroll in ANTHRO95B (Independent Study for Honors or Senior Paper Writing) in the final quarter of the undergraduate degree program and earn a grade of A- or better to graduate with honors.
